LESSON: SOCIAL FESTIVALS

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Utsav (Festivals)
Topic 7.1: Social festivals

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Social festivals. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.
